push.title: L 3-4 vs Los Pistoleroz | You: 8.5
push.body:
PhogsToffees, an 8.5 is above the line for a forward. Let's go hunting for the extra half point.

THE GOOD
+ Tackle success 67%, up from your usual 14%. Nobody hands out trophies for that, so here's my handshake.
+ 4 shots at Los Pistoleroz's goal. The more you shoot, the luckier you get.
+ 1 assist (down from your usual 2). Somebody's gonna owe you dinner for those passes.
+ That connection with BellyTb1 is the real deal. Find 'em early and often.
+ 7th straight match at 7.5 match rating. That's the version of you I'm building the team around.

THE BAD
- This loss burned our last chance in Division 2 and set up a relegation match. We'll talk about it as a group, then leave it behind us.
- Key passes 0, down from your usual 2. Quick fix: Arrive late at the edge of the box for cutbacks. That's where midfield chances come from.
- Tackles attempted 3, down from your usual 4. One honest look at that and we move forward.
- Pass accuracy: 85%. Decent, but top-quarter forwards get to 88%+. That's the next rung.
- Shots on target: 75%. Solid, but the best forwards hit 90%+.

Try this in practice: Switch play when they shift across. Quickest way to find space is usually on the far side.

PhogsToffees, write this on your hand if you have to: Every game is a teacher. Some just grade harder.

Keep the faith, partner. - Coach Lasso

push.title: L 3-4 vs Los Pistoleroz | You: 8.4
push.body:
BellyTb1, an 8.4. Like a good casserole, it's not fancy, but everybody's glad it showed up.

THE GOOD
+ 4 shots at Los Pistoleroz's goal. Their defense never got a moment of peace.
+ You and PhogsToffees were on the same wavelength, like two radios tuned to the good station.
+ Tackles won 3, up from your usual 1. Pure hustle, and hustle is free.
+ 5th straight match at 7.5 match rating. Write that one down and stick it on the fridge.
+ 4 goals conceded: +0.2. You did the boring stuff well, and it showed.

THE BAD
- This loss burned our last chance in Division 2 and set up a relegation match. That's the bill for the little mistakes, and we all chipped in.
- Completed passes 17, down from your usual 22. It's a small thing until it's the whole thing.
- 3 tackles won cost 0.2. Think of it as a pebble in your boot. Shake it out.
- Goals per shot on target: 50%. You're in the conversation. 60%+ wins the argument.
- Key passes: 1. Halfway to the summit; the peak is 2+.

Session plan: Show for it. Move into the passing lane and ask for the ball instead of hiding behind your marker.

One thought for the road, BellyTb1: The ball will find the player who wants it. Want it.

Ups and downs make a roller coaster, and roller coasters are fun. - Coach Lasso
